messages.subject: how many semi landmarks for good represenation?
parts:
Hi ! 

I study the shape of the vole molars and I put landmarks at fixed points but I do not know where or how many semilandmarks I need to have a good representation of the shape.

Is there a method to know how to semi-landmark I should place on the vole molars ? Is there scientific paper on this subject ?
Thanks :)

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] how many semi landmarks for good represenation?
parts:
Coline,

this article should be of help:

Collyer, Sekora & Adams 2015. A method for analysis of phenotypic change for phenotypes described by high-dimensional data. Heredity 115: 357-365.

https://www.nature.com/articles/hdy201475

Also, if you have curves digitized through StereoMorph, you can try to play with the argument nCurvePts in the geomorph function readland.shapes to sample different numbers of semilandmarks on your curves and evaluate how they perform for your question of interest.

Hope this helps

Antigoni
